say:1:1310819001:0.text: We're so sorry, Lady Valka. He was wearing armor very similar to yours. He must've been one of your comrades.
say:1:1310819001:0.source_cn: 对不起……瓦丽卡女士，他穿着和你很像的盔甲，肯定也是你...

say:2:1310819002:0.text: Chippy had no choice. He suddenly attacked us...
say:2:1310819002:0.source_cn: 满满也不想这样的，可是他突然攻击我们……

say:3:1310819003:1.text: No apology is necessary. The undead, once their sanity is lost, will prey upon the innocent. I was powerless to prevent it, and I lack the heart to slay them.
say:3:1310819003:1.source_cn: 不，不需要道歉。失去理智的活死人会攻击无辜生灵。我无法...

say:4:1310819004:0.source_cn: 这样对他们来说才是真正的解脱。

say:6:1310819005:0.text: Oh, look! "Oh Goddess, please bless Kaminsky", is this some sort of talisman?
say:6:1310819005:0.source_cn: 咦，“女神保佑扬·卡明斯基”……这似乎是个护身符？

say:8:1310819006:1.text: This fell from him. It must be important.
say:8:1310819006:1.source_cn: 这是从他身上掉下来的，这一定对他很重要！

say:10:1310819007:1.text: Kaminsky... I recall that he was a fervent youth, scarce 20 years of age. He had been wed for less than a year when he took to the battlefield.
say:10:1310819007:1.source_cn: 扬·卡明斯基……我记得他，一个还不满20岁的、热血沸腾...

say:11:1310819008:0.text: His family was prominent back then, and perhaps his descendants still reside in Whiteridge.
say:11:1310819008:0.source_cn: 卡明斯基家当年是个大家族，或许现在白山还有他们的后裔。

say:12:1310819009:0.text: Maybe after this matter is over, we can go look for his family and return the talisman to them.
say:12:1310819009:0.source_cn: 嗯……也许这件事结束以后，可以去找找，将这个护身符还给他们。
